# 可唔可以 + Verb？ · *ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 + Verb?*

**Meaning:** may I…? / could you…? · **Level:** A2 · **Topic:** Wants, needs and ability

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new).

可以 means 'may' or 'can' (permission or possibility). Its A-not-A form 可唔可以 is the standard polite request. Answer 可以 (yes) or 唔可以 (no).

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **可唔可以平啲呀？** |
| Jyutping | ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 peng4 di1 aa3? |
| Yale | hó m̀h hó yíh pèhng dī a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄏㄛ² ㆬ⁴ ㄏㄛ² ㄧ⁵ ㄆㄝㄥ⁴ ㄉㄧ¹ ㄚ³? |
| English | Could you make it a bit cheaper? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我可唔可以坐呢度呀？** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 co5 ni1 dou6 aa3? |
| Yale | ngóh hó m̀h hó yíh chóh nī douh a? |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄏㄛ² ㆬ⁴ ㄏㄛ² ㄧ⁵ ㄘㄛ⁵ ㄋㄧ¹ ㄉㄛㄨ⁶ ㄚ³? |
| English | May I sit here? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你可唔可以講慢啲呀？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 maan6 di1 aa3? |
| Yale | néih hó m̀h hó yíh góng maahn dī a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄏㄛ² ㆬ⁴ ㄏㄛ² ㄧ⁵ ㄍㄛㄥ² ㄇㄚㄣ⁶ ㄉㄧ¹ ㄚ³? |
| English | Could you speak a bit more slowly? |
